Get Introduced Powering High-Performing Stores Across the sales floor, our digital teammates leverage computer vision and artificial intelligence to accurately handle the work that keeps stores running at their best—so associates can be more focused on shoppers. What You Gain from a Digital Teammate Extended Team: Consistent feedback to help prioritize tasks. Reliability: Always on—no breaks, no distractions. Ready to perform every shift, without exception. Focus: Zeroed in on critical operational tasks, without ever being pulled away by customer demands or changing priorities. Adaptability: Seamlessly fits into your workflows and improves over time—getting smarter with every scan. Consistency: Delivers dependable results across every store, every shift, every time. Affordability: Solutions that fit comfortably within your store’s P&L—no upfront costs, no aging tech, just continuous innovation. Data Analytics & Services Better decisions start with better data. Every scan by our digital teammates generates insights that help you respond faster, optimize operations, and drive higher performance across all your stores. Transforms scans into real-time alerts and restocking priorities Identifies trends in pricing accuracy, product placement, and safety risks Generates reports that help teams measure impact, optimize workflows, and plan ahead With seamless integration into existing systems, these insights empower retailers to act with confidence—improving outcomes at both the store and enterprise level. SIGN UP FOR UPDATES Badger Technologies® provides actionable data and analytics for retail operations through automation solutions that include a fully autonomous robot to address out-of-stock, planogram compliance, price integrity and other operational inefficiencies. Actionable data and business analytics translates into improved store execution, lower operational costs and higher profits for retailers.
